caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher or ewer positioned centrally within a rectangular frame. The pitcher features a wide, scalloped body with decorative vertical fluting, a narrow neck that flares outward into a pronounced spout, and an elegantly curved handle attached at the top and base of the neck. The handle has detailed scrollwork. Ornamental bands with repeating floral and geometric motifs encircle three areas of the pitcher: around the rim, the widest part of the body, and at the top and base of the pedestal-like foot. The pitcher is shaded in grayscale, with darker and lighter tones used to suggest highlights and depth. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is an inset showing an enlarged detail of the ornamental band, emphasizing the intricacy of the pattern. The background is plain and unshaded, and the objects are rendered in fine, precise lines.
title: Silver Creamer
